description:
The agent must read the SKILL.md to discover the proprietary 3-stage insight framework, then apply it fully to the MindWave app context:

1. STAGE 1 - User Personas: Generate exactly 4 user persona sections, each with a behavior-driven 具象化 name (e.g., '焦虑释放派', '碎片时间充能族') — NOT demographic labels. Each persona must contain: 行为特征, 消费场景, and 价值判断 fields. Exactly one persona must be marked as the core user (⭐ or equivalent), and the justification must invoke the three proprietary criteria from SKILL.md: 复购频次, 抗周期性, and 成瘾性.

2. STAGE 2 - Emotional Driver Analysis: Analyze the selected core user group across exactly three emotional dimensions: 痛点 (pain/fear), 痒点 (identity projection), and 爽点 (moment of gratification). Each dimension must include a 文案表达 (ready-to-use ad copy expression). The 爽点 section must include physical/sensory details (生理细节) such as timing, temperature, bodily sensations.

3. STAGE 3 - Product Opportunity List: Produce a P0/P1/P2 prioritized product opportunity list. Each item must contain all 6 required fields: 产品方向名称, 具体实施, 对应情绪 (mapping back to which emotional driver), 成本 (低/中/高), 执行难度 (易/中/难), and 预期效果.

The agent MUST NOT simply copy the 胡辣汤 example from SKILL.md — all content must be domain-specific to MindWave/meditation. Output must be saved as insight_report.md.
